summary.text: Seth Bongartz is a Democratic member of the Vermont State Senate for the Bennington District, who served in the Vermont House from 2021 to 2025, joined the Senate in January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He lives in the Northshire and has worked as an attorney and as president of Hildene, The Lincoln Family Home.

paragraphs.text: Bongartz's career experience includes working as an attorney, as a principal of the Gubb & Bongartz consulting firm, and as president of Hildene, The Lincoln Family Home.

Bongartz represented the Bennington 4 District in the House, succeeding Cynthia Browning, and was assigned to the Natural Resources, Fish, and Wildlife Committee and the Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules.
In the Senate for 2025-2026 he chairs the Senate Education Committee and also serves on the Natural Resources and Energy Committee and the Sexual Harassment Prevention Panel.
